pokedexEntries.di: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

pokedexEntries.prl: Scientists discovered that the distinctive patterns on its back differ by region.

pokedexEntries.pt: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with REMORAID.

pokedexEntries.hgss: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back.

pokedexEntries.bw: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with Remoraid.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The pattern on its back varies by region. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.

pokedexEntries.as: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back.

pokedexEntries.us: It’s highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that take people swimming with Mantyke are a super-popular beach activity.

pokedexEntries.um: Mantyke are friendly toward people and will approach boats closely. The patterns on their backs differ depending on their habitat.

pokedexEntries.sw: Mantyke living in Galar seem to be somewhat sluggish. The colder waters of the seas in this region may be the cause.

pokedexEntries.sh: It swims along with a school of Remoraid, and they’ll all fight together to repel attackers.

pokedexEntries.bd: A friendly Pokémon that senses the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

pokedexEntries.shp: Scientists discovered that the distinctive patterns on its back differ by region.

pokedexEntries.la: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.
